name: promotion
note: The promotion rule as a goal (Game.promotes): a pawn of ours reaching its last rank is replaced by a queen, so its stake is the material valuation's worth of the queen less the pawn's (8); the pushes are the kernel's moves (Game.moves_to: every unit the promotion may place) and the unit placed is the one the material valuation values most (Game.placing_most: the queen; plan 75.4 (5)); a pawn within three pushes is a root (near, 52.6: the mate and material stakes dominate farther pawns; a far passer the tempo arithmetic calls unstoppable is one too), cited by no Lean theorem as a goal.
